explanation: The rules cap a golf ball at 45.93 g, while a tennis ball must weigh 56 to 59.4 g. The golf ball only feels heavier because it is small and solid.

claims.text: Under the Rules of Golf, a golf ball may weigh no more than 45.93 g.
Under the ITF Rules of Tennis, a standard tennis ball weighs between 56.0 and 59.4 g.
A golf ball is smaller and denser than a tennis ball.
